title: Magic Girl, Pretty Sammy
lyrics_plain:
Don't you ever worry, don't you get too wary
I am always here for you
Future's full of wonders, mystery all over
In the miracle you have faced
If you keep on dreaming, it sure will come true
The magic spell you chant will solve
And make all of your problems right
Thirsty may you be sometimes, say the magic words
And you'll have a drink
Hungry may you be sometimes, say the magic words
And you'll get everything you need
Boy you love and care for in your secret fancy may happen to be leaving you
Wonder magic power, the last remaining power, the magic power's on your side
Just watch and you'll see, the love you have longed
The magic spell you chant will bring the fortune always back for you
Make a blunder and be late, the magic force can bring you back a smile
All the tiresome work that you've got
You can just leave it, you just leave it all to me
Thirsty may you be sometimes, say the magic words
And you'll have..a drink
Hungry may you be sometimes, say the magic words
And you'll get everything you need
